pillar_reactions.evidence: The coaching pillars were never delivered — the rep disqualified the prospect before any presentation. Training and mobility appear only as a contents list for the self-guided product: 'a tutorial on every single kettlebell exercise, double kettlebell exercise, advanced kettlebell exercise, full mobility routines, full mobility tutorials.' The prospect's reaction to that catalogue was positive ('That's awesome... that's good enough for me') but it is a reaction to a product listing, not to the pillar.

Never delivered. Nutrition was discovered but not pitched — the rep learned the prospect already has a nutritionist and is primarily vegetarian, and used that as one of his reasons to route him away from the coaching rather than as something to address. The obvious tension between a red-meat-forward programme and a vegetarian household was never raised by either party.

The one pillar that was described, as the coaching's point of difference — 'working with Trevor one-on-one, having Trevor kind of customize everything for you and be in there for you all the time, 24-7' — and the prospect rejected it on the substance, twice: 'I don't really need live input or anything like that. I'm pretty self-driven', and later 'I'm pretty much no-nonsense. I'm self-driven. I don't really need, you know, like, hand-holding, per se.' The rep did not test the claim; he accepted it and downsold.

anchors.raw: It is. It's about $1,000 a month. It's $6,000 for the six months. Primal University is like $200. And I feel like for what you want, it's probably a better fit anyway.
anchors.competitor: Primal University, Primal's own self-guided product
anchors.note: The decisive anchor and it was created by the rep, who placed $6,000 and $200 in the same sentence and recommended the $200. This is the fourth call in the batch where the rep introduced the cheaper internal product himself. Here it was done deliberately and honestly as a disqualification rather than as a retreat under pressure, which distinguishes it from the Bryan Langsdale and Marc Moubarak calls, but the mechanic is identical.

anchors.raw: So I've tried some kettlebell workouts before. They led to a lot of success, I think, in helping develop strength, mobility.
anchors.competitor: Self-taught kettlebell training learned from friends
anchors.note: He has already achieved the outcome once, for free, with knowledge picked up socially. That is a hard ceiling on what instruction is worth to him, and it went unchallenged — nobody asked why, if it worked, he is now at his heaviest ever.

anchors.raw: recently I got a nutritionist and I became aware of portion sizes and how many calories I was actually downing, which is a lot.
anchors.note: One of the three pillars is already bought elsewhere and only a month old, which cuts the perceived value of the bundle by a third before it is presented. The rep treated it as a reason to disqualify rather than as a consolidation argument, which is the opposite of how he handled the same situation with Marc Moubarak the previous day.

anchors.raw: I will say the cost would have been an issue with one-on-one coaching. I'm not there yet. In a year, I would be.
anchors.note: A resident's salary against a $6,000 lump sum. The important detail is the expiry date he attached to it — the same twelve months after which his schedule also stabilises. That makes him a diarised future opportunity rather than a loss, and nothing was set.

unmet_demand.want: Programming that flexes to the time actually available on a given day — 15 minutes when a shift eats the day, 30 to 45 when it does not, with the shortfall made up rather than written off
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He described exactly what he wanted and it was never answered: 'let's say I could fit in a 15 minute workout today. We'll make up for it tomorrow when you have the ability to do 30, 45 minutes. But here's what you just knock out today and go about your day.' Whether the coaching adapts session length to a rotating shift pattern is genuinely unknown from anything said, and it is the single thing that would have justified one-on-one over a static library for this prospect.

unmet_demand.want: A nutrition approach that works for a primarily vegetarian household
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Never addressed on this call. The programme is presented elsewhere as red meat, eggs and dairy forward, and the same rep has said on other calls that vegetarian clients are accommodated. Here the vegetarianism was heard and dropped, and it may well have contributed to the decision to route him to a self-guided product.

unmet_demand.want: Instruction on the movements he never learned, the Turkish get-up in particular
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Served by the tutorial library in the self-guided product, so not a gap in itself. Recorded because it is the clearest example on the call of a need the coaching also serves better, which was never argued.
